seg = current_frame.segmentation
for n in seg['nodes']:
    b = n['boundary']
    rows = [p[0] for p in b]
    cols = [p[1] for p in b]
    rmin, rmax = min(rows), max(rows)
    cmin, cmax = min(cols), max(cols)
    print(f"  {n['color']}: {n['pixels']}px, [{rmin},{cmin}]-[{rmax},{cmax}]")
print(f"level_completed: {last_action_result.get('level_completed')}")
print(f"gameplay_changed: {last_action_result.get('gameplay_changed')}")

# If not, let me check if the blue bar changed color or size
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'b':
        print(f"Blue bar: {n['pixels']}px, hash={n['hash']}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
